runtimeRefreshDesc: Graph data is refreshed through commit sync and background git-status updates.
runtimeDegradedDesc: Some chapters' Git status could not be read right now, so the graph is continuing with cached data. If this persists, check the affected chapter worktree or branch state.

nodeDock.expandLimitReached: Up to {{limit}} nodes can be expanded at once. Collapse one first.
nodeDock.layoutLoadFailed: Could not load this node's panel layout.
nodeDock.releaseToDetach: Release to detach as its own node
nodeDock.detachLimitReached: Up to {{limit}} panels can be detached from one chapter. Close one first.
nodeDock.detachDuplicate: That panel is already detached on the canvas.
nodeDock.mergeForeignChapter: Only panels from the same chapter can be merged.
nodeDock.zoomToInteract: Zoom in to use this node's panels

contextMenu.forkRequiresActive: Only active or dormant chapters can be forked. This one is merged or abandoned.
contextMenu.dormantRequiresWorktree: This chapter has no worktree, so there is nothing to make dormant.
contextMenu.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete chapter "{{title}}"? The worktree and branch will be removed. Conversations will be preserved as read-only.
contextMenu.deleteConfirmMessageNoWorktree: Are you sure you want to delete chapter "{{title}}"? It has no worktree, so its git branch is left in place and you may need to remove it yourself. Conversations will be preserved as read-only.

selection.mergeDecisionContinueSent: Checking resolved conflicts and continuing merge
selection.mergeDecisionCancelSent: Merge flow cancellation sent; the chapter is preserved
selection.mergeDecisionFailed: Unable to send merge decision; WebSocket is disconnected.
selection.mergeAiResolving: Conflict resolution narrator started in the merge chapter

mergeDraft.unsupported: Batch merge is unavailable in this backend runtime.

terminal.closeConfirmMessage: This terminal has running processes. Are you sure you want to close it?

ruler.mergeConflictResolvedDesc: AI resolved {{count}} conflicting file(s) and completed the merge.
ruler.mergeConflictFailedDesc: AI could not resolve conflicts in: {{files}}. A temporary chapter has been created for manual resolution.
ruler.mergeDirtySource: Commit-mode merge needs a clean chapter worktree. Commit or stash its changes, or merge in workspace mode, where uncommitted changes are fine.
ruler.mergeDirtyTrunk: Commit-mode merge needs a clean trunk worktree. Commit or stash trunk's changes, or merge in workspace mode, where uncommitted changes are fine.
ruler.rebaseNarratorSentDesc: The narrator will resolve rebase conflicts.
ruler.rebaseParkedWorkConflict: Uncommitted changes set aside by an earlier rebase conflict with the current workspace. Resolve them before rebasing again.
ruler.rebaseParkedWorkUnsettled: Uncommitted changes set aside by an earlier rebase could not be put back, because the workspace could not be read. Your work is still in the snapshot; retry once the worktree is readable.
ruler.parkedSnapshotUnresolvable: The parked work can no longer be recovered — its snapshot no longer resolves.
ruler.rebaseReapplyConflict: Rebase done, uncommitted changes need attention
ruler.rebaseReapplyConflictDesc: The rebase succeeded, but your uncommitted changes conflict with the rebased result. They are safe in snapshot {{snapshot}}.
ruler.rebaseReapplyFailed: Rebase done, restoring your changes failed
ruler.rebaseReapplyFailedDesc: The rebase succeeded, but putting your uncommitted changes back failed: {{error}}. They are safe in snapshot {{snapshot}}.
ruler.parkedWorkLost: Earlier parked changes could not be recovered
ruler.parkedWorkLostDesc: Uncommitted work set aside by an earlier rebase (snapshot {{snapshot}}) can no longer be recovered, so the chapter was released to continue.
ruler.parkedWorkRetriedDesc: Your parked changes were merged back into the workspace.
ruler.parkedWorkMaterializedDesc: Your parked changes were written into {{count}} file(s), with conflict markers where the two sides disagree. Resolve them in your editor.
ruler.parkedWorkDiscardedDesc: NarraFork will stop tracking snapshot {{snapshot}}. The snapshot itself is still in the shadow repository.
ruler.parkedWorkDiscardConfirmDesc: NarraFork will stop tracking snapshot {{snapshot}} and will no longer offer to restore it.
ruler.parkedWorkActionFailed: Could not recover the parked changes
ruler.parkedWorkOutstandingDesc: An earlier rebase set uncommitted changes aside in snapshot {{snapshot}} and they are still not back on disk. Rebasing this chapter again is blocked until you deal with them.
ruler.offRulerChaptersDesc: Their starting commit is outside the loaded part of the timeline, so there is no tick to place them on.
ruler.offRulerChaptersExhausted: The whole timeline is loaded and their starting commits still could not be located. Open these chapters from the chapter list or search.
ruler.rewrittenAnchorChapters: {{count}} chapter(s) shown at their fork point: {{titles}}
ruler.rewrittenAnchorChaptersDesc: A rebase or squash-merge rewrote the commit they record as their start, so it is no longer on this branch. They are drawn where they diverged from trunk, which is an approximate position.
